most_informative_results: Prospective inference authority appears across public acquisition, military, enforcement, health, banking, and platform systems; this alone does not establish abuse or one coordinated class.
The DCGS-A2 litigation is the strongest positive control for preventive counterpower because an independent court shifted a burden before award without selecting the challenger.
No record contains direct represented-person voice, so subject awareness, consent, injury, and practical standing remain unresolved rather than inferred.
Evidence custody is repeatedly fragmented across public institutions, vendors, source systems, users, reviewers, and affected people; fragmentation is not automatically deliberate concealment.
NGC2, NHS procurement, Brave1, and the Fundrise Erebor record provide material controls against total counterfactual foreclosure or exclusive-network explanations.
Human involvement and formal appeal remain separate from meaningful time, understanding, veto, stay, reversal, and practical exit.

The cross-system monopoly proposition remains candidate-only until repeated rights-holder identity, direct subject voice, consequence, remedy, comparator, and causal error-benefit chains are complete.
admission_rule: Canonical admission requires at least two source-complete systems with inference authority, threshold, evidence custody, direct affected-person voice, consequence, remedy, comparator, and observed exit or preventive stay.
